title: AGN-199201 for the Treatment of Erythema With Rosacea
brief_summary: This study will evaluate the safety and efficacy of 3 doses of AGN-199201 once and twice daily compared to vehicle for the treatment of moderate to severe facial erythema associated with rosacea.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Redness of the skin caused by rosacea

Exclusion Criteria:

* ≥3 inflammatory lesions
* Laser light-source or other energy based therapy in the last 6 months
* Any prescription or over the counter product for the treatment of acne or rosacea in the last 14 days
